data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 were GBP 250.457m. Using the gross claims development table, there is a small net favourable prior-year development of approximately GBP 3.83m (a ~1.53% release of opening gross reserves) driven by releases in older years (notably 2012 and 2013) partially offset by adverse development in 2011 and 2014. Management attributes increases in technical provisions during the year principally to IBNR related to higher gross premiums written and business growth.

This includes an increase in unearned premiums and claims outstanding, principally as IBNR, attributed to increased gross premiums written in the year.
Reinsurers' share of claims outstanding as at 31 December 2016 is GBP 62.6m compared to GBP 18.8m as at the prior year.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure derived from the gross claims development triangle (aggregate comparison of older underwriting years) because no single explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was provided. Triangle-based calculation excludes 2015 and 2016 as required. Some line-by-line premium amounts were reconstructed from the segmental table and summed to match the reported total; small risk of transcription/rounding differences. Page numbers are approximate (extracted from scanned images).
